FilterList(OnixCommandOrigin, IEnumerable<Entity>)

Filters a list of entity according to the selector based on the origin. Be careful with this as InsufficientTrustException will be thrown hrown when ran on the client from an untrusted plugin when you access the entity list. To safely do this, call the GetEntities(OnixCommandOrigin) method instead which checks for this.

public List<Entity> FilterList(OnixCommandOrigin origin, IEnumerable<Entity> entities)
